newsitem.title: KENYA: Nairobi students protest against police killing.
newsitem.headline: Nairobi students protest against police killing.

text.p: Hundreds of university students marched in Kenya's capital on Friday carrying the coffin of a 20-year-old student in protest at his killing by police late last month.
With the coffin of Anthony Chege shoulder high, the students marched to the gates of parliament and police headquarters followed at a distance by riot police, who did not intervene.
Chege was shot dead by police in a Nairobi housing estate on March 28 shortly before he was to enter university as a first year student. He was the fourth student killed by police since December.

Police said Chege was a suspected robber. Nairobi university only reopened last month, having been closed by authorities in February because of riots at the death of student leader Solomon Muruli, whose charred body was found in his dormitory room.
Kenya is to hold presidential and parliamentary elections this year. Kenyan students have no political agenda, at least in public, and usually protest only about fees and conditions.
